name: Verify G+ (Inductive)
description: Measures inductive reasoning ability - the ability to draw inferences and understand relationships between various concepts independent of acquired knowledge.

name: Verify G+ (Deductive)
description: Measures deductive reasoning ability - the ability to draw logical conclusions based on information provided, identify strengths and weaknesses of arguments, and complete scenarios using incomplete information.

name: Verify G+ (Numerical)
description: Measures numerical reasoning ability - the ability to make correct decisions or inferences from numerical data.

name: OPQ (Occupational Personality Questionnaire)
description: Provides an indication of an individual's preferred behavioral style at work. Helps gauge suitability for a role, team, and organization.

name: MQ (Motivation Questionnaire)
description: Measures the situations that are likely to increase or reduce an individual's motivation to work.

name: Coding Assessment
description: Assesses coding skills in various programming languages through real-world tasks.

name: Situational Judgment Test (SJT)
description: Presents realistic work-related scenarios to assess judgment and decision-making skills.

name: Verify Interactive - Calculation
description: Assesses the ability to perform numerical calculations quickly and accurately in a work context.

name: Verify Interactive - Checking
description: Measures the ability to quickly and accurately compare information.
